description: This file defines the Entity class 'EmploymentStatus' for the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It maps to the database table 'ohrm_employment_status' and includes properties such as 'id' and 'name', along with a one-to-many relationship to 'Employee' entities. The class provides getter and setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: EmploymentStatus
classes.description: Entity representing employment status with properties for ID, name, and associated employees, mapped to a database table with ORM annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the employment status.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the employment status.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the employment status.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the employment status.

methods.name: getEmployees
methods.description: Returns the collection of employees associated with this employment status.

methods.name: setEmployees
methods.description: Sets the collection of employees associated with this employment status.
